<!-- Keep it short. Conventional Commits welcome (e.g., feat:, fix:, docs:, chore:) -->

Summary
- What changed and why (1–2 sentences).

Related
- Closes #<id> (optional)

Verification
- How you tested or verified (brief steps; logs/screenshots if helpful).

Impact
- Breaking changes? No / Yes (explain)
- Docs updated? N/A / link

Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated or N/A
- [ ] Docs/release notes updated if user-facing
